servicio.title: Full stack development for your project
servicio.lede: I help small businesses get their first web application: from understanding what you need to having it live and running.

pasos.texto: We talk through what you need and turn it into concrete features, without technical jargon.
Interface and the complete system, frontend and backend, tested before delivery.
I put it online, with its own domain and ready for your customers to use.
Maintenance and support once the application is in use.
